name: Lucasfilm Quotes
description: A quote from a Lucasfilm movie on every refresh — Star Wars, Indiana Jones, Willow, Labyrinth and more — word-wrapped and centered with the character who said it underneath. Only quotes that fit the board, so a Note gets the short ones and a Flagship the long ones too. Optionally only from the franchises, movies or characters you choose. 537 quotes from 23 movies, shipped with the plugin — nothing to download, no API key.
author: Oliver Rummeyer

franchises.title: Franchises
franchises.description: Optional. Only quotes from the movies of these franchises. Leave empty for any.

movies.title: Movies
movies.description: Optional. Only quotes from these movies. Combined with franchises, each quote is from one of the chosen franchises or one of the chosen movies.

characters.title: Characters
characters.description: Optional. Only quotes by these characters. Combined with franchises or movies, each quote is by one of the chosen characters and from one of the chosen franchises or movies.

character_name.title: Character name
character_name.description: Sign the quote with the name of the character who said it, shortened to the name they go by when the full one does not fit. When it fits leaves the name off when the quote needs every row; Always picks only quotes with room for the name — on a Note 99 of the 221 that fit.
enumNames: Always (only quotes with room for it)

skip_swearing.title: Skip swearing
skip_swearing.description: Leave out the handful of quotes with a damn, hell or bastard in them.

alignment.title: Alignment
alignment.description: Centered puts the name centered underneath; left-aligned puts it flush right.

refresh_seconds.title: Refresh Interval
refresh_seconds.description: How long a quote stays on the board before the next one.

quote.description: The quote as board text, unwrapped

character.description: The full name of the character who said it, as they go by in the movie

movie.description: The movie the quote is from
movie.example: STAR WARS: EPISODE VI - RETURN OF THE JEDI

year.description: The year the movie came out

franchise.description: The franchise of the movie, empty for a movie outside one

block.description: The whole laid-out board as one value, rows separated by newlines. Put this on the first template line to fill the board.

line4.description: Board row 4 of the layout, empty on a Note

line5.description: Board row 5 of the layout, empty on a Note

line6.description: Board row 6 of the layout, empty on a Note
